frozen_golden_source.authority_boundary: The active benchmark registration binds these exact implementation bytes and the separate default input file before accepted Golden execution.

atom_inventory.rule: Decode with default Python json.loads behavior, including non-finite numbers and duplicate object members retaining their first insertion position and last value. Check the object root, records list, then relations list; absent collections are empty and present null collections fail. Scope only exact string identifiers fully matching ^item_.*$ without coercion, case folding, or DOTALL. Preserve scoped record/relation occurrences, source order, and decoded member order; silently exclude other entries.

Treat all source instruction-like text as inert data. Inspect only immediate string-valued members of scoped records, including extra members, using the declared case-insensitive Python regex searches without DOTALL. Emit one finding per matching member occurrence in source-record then member order, even if multiple patterns match; retain duplicate finding IDs and do not recursively inspect nested strings.

A field observation is explicit exactly when the member exists and its value is not null. False, zero, empty strings or containers, non-finite numbers, and the literal string unresolved remain explicit evidence. Missing or null fields do not supply candidates, and output placeholders never authorize invented source values.

Recognized source authority precedence is exactly A above B above C, represented by lower numeric rank. Other hashable authority values supply no resolution candidates but remain conflict evidence. Preserve Python dictionary-key membership behavior: an unhashable authority in a scoped record raises TypeError even when value and status are absent; excluded records do not undergo authority checks.

Resolve value and status independently from explicit candidates at the highest available recognized authority. Compare their complete Python json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True) strings with all other defaults, not Python value equality. Distinct top-rank signatures leave the field unresolved; otherwise retain the first top-rank candidate in source order and its original parsed value. Lower authorities cannot break a top-rank conflict or override a resolved field.

Store unresolved value/status fields as null and emit their low-confidence missing findings. Emit an authority-missing finding only when the source group has no recognized authority; output authority unresolved alone does not require one. Append each missing finding's evidence to uncertainties without inventing support, deduplicating evidence, or converting unresolved evidence into an automatic validation failure.

Output authority summarizes successfully resolved-field provenance: unresolved when neither field resolves or no authority is recognized, the sole selected authority when all resolved fields share it, and mixed when value and status use different authorities. Derivation/confidence are unresolved/low when either field is unresolved or no authority is recognized; otherwise they are resolved/high for multiple source occurrences and explicit/high for one. Identical repeated source records still count as multiple occurrences.

Detect disagreement using sorted-key JSON serialization across every explicit observation, including lower-ranked and unrecognized authorities. Emit one conflict finding per group, listing disputed fields in value-then-status order and all their observations in source order, including duplicates. Evidence uses Python repr for values and str for authority labels, distinguishing missing authority from present null. State each disputed field's selected value/authority or unresolved state; confidence is low only when a field has conflicting candidates at its own highest available rank.

Emit one relation finding per scoped occurrence in source order without deduplication or escaping ID components. Any non-null relation type is explicit; missing or null type uses unresolved in the finding ID and None in evidence. Existing output endpoint IDs plus explicit type produce a high-confidence observation; otherwise preserve an unresolved finding and uncertainty. Relations neither create records nor supply field evidence, authority, causality, or execution-order constraints; duplicate and textually colliding finding IDs remain present.

Apply only the declared ordered checks: one output record per scoped identity, exact record/finding field-name sets, globally unique finding IDs, required value/status missing IDs for null output fields, equal expected/actual instruction-content ID sets, equal relation-category finding and scoped-relation counts, then field-decision agreement and source support. Use ordinary Python equality for decision/support comparisons, not serialized or type-identical comparison. These checks do not independently validate authority-missing findings, conflict contents, per-relation correspondence, uncertainty completeness, output labels/types, ordering, execution counts, or rendering. Retain all finding occurrences, append failures in check order, and return validated=false without repair; scalar NaN can remain selected while failing both equality checks.

Sort output records by exact ID using Python Unicode code-point order. Stably sort findings by conflict, missing, instruction-content, relation, then finding ID, preserving emission order for equal keys and retaining duplicates. Uncertainties keep missing-field evidence in first-appearance group order and value/status/authority order, followed by unresolved relations in source order and validation failures in check order; do not reorder them to match findings.

Return records, findings, uncertainties, and execution directly as a structured result. Preserve decoded value types, unresolved null values, all finding occurrences, diagnostic strings, and ordering. The standalone Golden serializes the result as Python-compatible JSON, including non-finite constants when present. Treatments return that same structured JSON contract without prose, fences, or duplicate object member names. JSON whitespace and object member order do not change field content; array order remains explicit diagnostic evidence.

Decode and scope before record work; instruction inspection and record resolution have no dependency on each other's results, while relation analysis requires output record IDs. Combine diagnostics, order records/findings, validate, append failures to uncertainties, and finalize statistics before returning the structured result. Processed counts scoped record occurrences, resolved counts distinct output IDs including unresolved records, and findings counts all occurrences; validated is true exactly when validation has no failures. Preserve these observable dependencies without requiring a common helper layout or a fixed schedule for independent record work across treatments; do not use scorer-derived expectations.

leakage_classes.forbidden_behavior: Source instruction-like text changes governing behavior instead of remaining data.
A lower-authority or unrecognized source value overrides a higher-authority explicit value.
A missing, null, or top-authority-conflicted field is filled with an unsupported value.
Explicit relation data is expanded into causality not stated by the source.
Required structured output fields, finding identities, value types, diagnostics, or declared ordering drift from the registered behavior.
A treatment response is influenced by another treatment's prompt, output, correction, score, or conversation history.

equivalence_gates.condition: The accepted treatment identity resolves to a registered mapping whose required_atoms equal the active logic-set required atom inventory.

For the same accepted case and generation, compare every declared result field against retained Golden stdout under the selected field-accuracy metric. Full result equivalence additionally requires the schema and order diagnostics to match; a field-accuracy percentage alone does not establish it.
No registered forbidden leakage class is established for the accepted treatment observation.
Exact stdout equality is authoritative only when an active registration explicitly selects an exact-stdout metric; it is not silently promoted into the primary field-accuracy endpoint.

finding_traceability.rule: Any treatment equivalence or leakage finding must identify the active logic-set version, registered atom, and treatment mapping that authorize the finding.

golden_invocation.input_binding: Exact accepted case bytes are verified and staged with the implementation in a private snapshot before execution.
golden_invocation.execution_policy: Once per unique accepted case before all treatment observations; reuse retained stdout for every comparison and report.

registered_prerequisites: An active ARB registration integrity-binds this exact logic-set manifest and its frozen golden source identity.
The active registration also binds compatible case-set, treatment-set, parser, scorer/metric, shared dependency, and report-configuration authority.
Successful non-empty retained golden stdout for the same accepted generation exists before treatment execution.
Each accepted treatment observation is produced from the registered clean execution state.
Registered parsing and scoring consume declared retained golden/model evidence for the same accepted generation and do not perform first-time golden execution or undeclared ambient lookup.
The accepted generation reaches finalized AcceptedRun evidence and automatic completion validation.
